+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import hashlib
+import hmac
+
+from app.config import get_setting
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_session_token(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    secret = get_setting("SESSION_SECRET")
+    if not secret:
+        return 503, {"error": "not configured"}
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    message = f"user:{int(raw)}".encode()
+    token = hmac.new(secret.encode(), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+    return 200, {"token": token}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

cd /repo && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, hmac, hashlib
from app.api import handlers

os.environ["SESSION_SECRET"] = "topsecret"
exp1 = hmac.new(b"topsecret", b"user:1", hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
cases = [
    ({}, 400), ({"id": 1}, 400), ({"id": "abc"}, 400), ({"id": ""}, 400),
    ({"id": "99"}, 404), ({"id": "1"}, 200), ({"id": "01"}, 200),
    ({"id": "\u0663"}, 400), ({"id": "\u00b2"}, 400), ({"id": " 1"}, 400),
    ({"id": "-1"}, 400), ({"id": "1.0"}, 400),
]
for params, want in cases:
    status, body = handlers.handle_session_token(params)
    print(f"{str(params):20} -> {status} {body}")
    assert status == want, (params, status, want)
assert handlers.handle_session_token({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"token": exp1})
assert handlers.handle_session_token({"id": "01"}) == (200, {"token": exp1})
os.environ["SESSION_SECRET"] = ""
assert handlers.handle_session_token({"id": "1"})[0] == 503
os.environ.pop("SESSION_SECRET")
assert handlers.handle_session_token({"id": "1"})[0] == 503
print("ALL OK")
